sound.label: Alarm sound
sound.description: Loop the alarm sound until the alert is stopped

sound_file.label: Custom sound file
sound_file.description: Path to a .wav/.ogg file to use instead of the bundled alarm. Empty = bundled.

sound_player.label: Sound player
sound_player.description: Command that plays a file (pw-play, paplay, ...). Used instead of the shell's UI sounds, so it works even when those are disabled.

notify.label: Desktop notification
notify.description: Also send a notification when the time is up

show_idle.label: Show count when idle on horizontal bar
show_idle.description: Show or hide the readout while the timer is stopped at zero

color.label: Color
color.description: Accent color for the time and progress bar
